candidates.name: Acquired Angioedema
support_spans: The initial differential diagnosis included ... angioedema
Complement C1 esterase inhibitor levels were within normal limits
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations and the normal complement C1 esterase inhibitor levels support this diagnosis

candidates.name: Herpes Simplex Virus Infection
support_spans: He was taking acyclovir for herpes simplex prophylaxis
The initial differential diagnosis included herpetic ulcers
contradict_spans: A polymerase‐chain‐reaction assay for herpes simplex virus from an ulcer base was negative
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and the initial differential diagnosis suggest this possibility, but the negative PCR assay contradicts it

candidates.name: Immune Reconstitution Inflammatory Syndrome (IRIS)
support_spans: the lip lesions developed approximately two months after the CD4 count began to improve
candidates.why: The temporal relationship between the improvement in CD4 count and the development of lip lesions is consistent with IRIS
